description: This file defines a LightningJS component named 'Loader' that displays a sequence of animated circles as a loading indicator. It includes properties, state management, lifecycle hooks, and methods specific to the component's behavior.

classes.name: Loader
classes.description: A LightningJS component for displaying a loading indicator with animated circles.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts an interval which toggles the alpha value of circles to animate a fade-in and fade-out effect.
